title.zh: 关于AI指数增长的政策建议
title.en: Policy on the AI Exponential (28 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic建议采用类似FAA的监管方式，进行强制测试并加强安全标准，同时调整宏观经济和税收系统以适应AI驱动的增长。
summary.en: AI advances rapidly, outpacing slow policy-making, leading to potential risks in cybersecurity and job displacement. Anthropic recommends a regulatory approach like the FAA for AI, mandatory testing, and stronger security standards to address these risks. Additional policy areas include adapting macroeconomics and tax systems for AI-driven growth, reforming regulations to enhance AI's biomedical impacts, and ensuring AI aligns with democratic values globally.

title.zh: DiffusionGemma：4倍加速文本生成的26B模型
title.en: DiffusionGemma: 4x faster text generation (5 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型通过文本扩散技术实现更快的文本生成，适合速度关键型应用，并针对NVIDIA硬件优化。
summary.en: DiffusionGemma, a 26B Mixture of Experts model, uses text diffusion for faster text generation, offering up to 4x speed increase on GPUs by generating text blocks simultaneously. It targets speed-critical applications, providing advantages like low latency and bi-directional attention, and fits in high-end consumer GPUs when quantized. While it trades some quality for speed compared to standard models, it allows for efficient local inference and is optimized for NVIDIA hardware.

title.zh: 护城河需要模型：全面反馈循环的价值
title.en: Moats Need Models (6 minute read)

summary.zh: 文章探讨了模型、工具、工作流和评估循环的整合如何构建竞争壁垒，强调拥有完整反馈循环的重要性。
summary.en: The model, harness, workflow, and evaluation loop are no longer separate stack pieces but co-design surfaces that compound together. Defensibility comes from owning the full feedback loop rather than renting frontier capability that can be restricted, repriced, or reclaimed on the supplier's terms.

title.zh: 无需生成：直接探测LLM隐藏状态的新方法
title.en: Don't let the LLM speak, just probe it (8 minute read)

summary.zh: 研究表明，通过探测LLM的隐藏状态，可以跳过生成过程，直接实现分类任务。
summary.en: Answers often already exist in LLMs' hidden state before they generate a single token. It's possible to skip generation entirely by grabbing the hidden state at the last prompt token, feeding it to a tiny multilayer perceptron, and calibrating the output. This results in a frozen model that acts as any classifier that can be written in English.

title.zh: 评估LLM对N日漏洞的影响
title.en: Measuring LLMs' impact on N-day exploits (18 minute read)

summary.zh: AI技术加速了从补丁中逆向工程漏洞的过程，使得未及时更新补丁的设备面临更大威胁。
summary.en: N-days are vulnerabilities that have already been publicly disclosed, but only patched on some devices. They can be more dangerous than zero-day vulnerabilities as the patches provide a roadmap to the bugs. The process of reverse-engineering a vulnerability from a patch has historically been slow and specialized work, but AI can accelerate and automate the process. This means anyone in the patch gap today faces a much larger threat than before.

summary.zh: Bugbot更新后运行速度提升3倍，成本降低22%，每次审查发现的错误增加10%。
summary.en: Cursor updated Bugbot to run over 3x faster, cost 22% less, and find 10% more bugs per review. Most runs now finished in under three minutes, shortening the review loop for developers.

summary.en: Palantir's CEO, Alex Karp, says the company's enterprise customers are unhappy with how frontier AI labs are operating. He claims these labs only care about burning through AI tokens to signal productivity. Accelerating costs are raising alarm among businesses and fueling efficiency concerns.

title.zh: 欧盟要求Meta停止封锁竞争对手AI聊天机器人
title.en: EU Orders Meta To Stop Blocking Rival AI Chatbots On WhatsApp (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 欧盟命令Meta向竞争对手的聊天机器人免费开放WhatsApp API，Meta计划对此决定提出上诉。
summary.en: The EU has ordered Meta to open up WhatsApp to chatbots from rival companies for free. Meta banned third-party AI chatbots from the WhatsApp for Business API in October last year. The EU said Meta was abusing its dominant position in the European messaging app by preventing competing assistants from using the WhatsApp API. Meta plans to appeal the decision, saying the order is a regulatory overreach that would grant some of the world's largest companies access to the API without paying.

title.zh: Claude托管代理的演进：构建生产级代理
